status_meaning: The final narrative agrees with the frozen local measurements and their limits; no capability acceptance.
review_scope: This follow-up only: four branch rows, six body-NLL rows, local direct source bindings and causal wording. No historical audit replay.
narrative_findings: All four pairwise canonical-minus-historical margins flip positive to negative; this is kept distinct from absolute canonical probability, which rises in two cases and falls in two.
All four enabled local top1 IDs match historical branch tokens. Disabled top1 is canonical in two cases and a third token in two, so no disabled-task success is inferred.
The body-NLL improvement is measured on teacher-forced canonical prefixes, excludes EOS/newline, and is not called autonomous repair quality.
BPE fragments are explicitly distinguished from complete actions; downstream canonical prefixes cannot describe the actual generated history after divergence.
Historical repair quality remains 2/6; no new semantic score, unseen-input claim, training-cause identification or production readiness is asserted.
One model object is used with fixed arm order and one measurement. Full-prefix versus cached-decoding and unmeasured training interventions remain explicit limits.
